label: Binary completion
description: Share of tasks where every scoring checkpoint passed.

label: Partial score
description: Mean share of scoring checkpoints reached, even when the task was not finished.

label: Accuracy
description: Share of tasks answered or completed correctly.

label: Resolved
description: Share of software-engineering issues resolved against the test suite.

label: Full completion
description: Binary share of tasks with all checkpoints passed.

label: Partial completion
description: Weighted progress score that credits checkpoints plus a full-completion bonus.

label: Elo
description: Preference-based rating from paired head-to-head judging.

label: Tool invocation rate
description: Share of tasks where the agent actually invoked the required tool.
